title: 未用于开发的括号检查委托

stages.goal: Create brackets.mjs, a dependency-free Node CLI. It reads a JSON string from stdin and prints one JSON boolean: whether (), [] and {} are correctly balanced and nested. Ignore all other characters, accept empty strings, reject unmatched closing/opening brackets and crossed nesting. Publish the script, independently inspect and execute it, then finish.
criteria: The CLI accepts a JSON string and correctly validates balanced and nested bracket types
